title: An outside judge's grades of one deck version, graded alone (project-kit#3397)
description: The document an outside judge writes for one deck version, graded alone in a session that saw no other version (plan.md, section 2). Its grades take the review document's form, so `analyse.py` reads them as it reads a review's, and adds `words`: the rule's own words behind a grade, which a grade below professional must give for a per-rule reference to rest on it. A grade below professional without them stands for the bar, and for no per-rule reference.

judge.description: Which judge, as the plan names it: `judge-1` or `judge-2`.

folder.description: The code of the folder graded, as the folder's name gives it.

model.description: The model the judge ran on, by its full name.

read.description: What the judge read before it graded, by kind, and what exactly.

grades.description: A grade for each rule of COMM and GRAPHIC on each page that takes one, and once for the piece for a rule that judges the pages together.

not-graded.description: Each rule that takes no grade on a page, or for the piece, with the passage of the rule's text that leaves it out.

place.description: A page, by the id `handed.md` gives it, or the piece as a whole.

words.description: On a grade below professional: each passage of the rule's text, word for word, that the page breaks. A per-rule reference rests on the grade only where every passage is the rule's own words.
